_comment: Synthetic application profile (spec 014). Import YOUR profile into the profile store as kind application_profile (json format); this example documents the shape and doubles as the public test fixture (services/api/tests/test_apply.py). deterministic_answers templates may use {company}, {product_signal}, {salary_min}, and {salary_target} placeholders.

ai_tooling_workflow.real_example: Built a local automation that drafts application materials from verified truth sources with validation gates.

professional_stories.summary: Improved a signup funnel's completion from about 40% to 70% across roughly 250K annual applications.
Built an AI-assisted local automation pipeline with truth-source validation for application materials.

do_not_claim: Do not claim React Native experience
Do not claim Cursor as an actual tool
Do not claim backend ownership beyond adjacent utilities

How do you use AI tools in your workflow.guidance: Name the actual tools and the real local automation example; do not inflate.

Why are you interested in this role/comp.guidance: Tie interest to the product signal and verified delivery work.

selection_guidance: Favor proof points that match the JD over the most impressive-sounding ones.
For frontend roles, prefer user-facing ownership, performance, and design systems.

interest.short: I'm interested in this role because it fits my background in TypeScript-first product engineering and user-facing delivery.
interest.medium: I'm interested in {company} because {product_signal}. This role fits my background well: TypeScript-first frontend and product engineering, shipping user-facing features end to end, and improving performance and reliability in production.
notes: Use JD language where it maps directly to verified experience.

fit.short: This role fits my background well because my strongest work is TypeScript-first frontend and product engineering.
fit.medium: My background is strongest in TypeScript-first frontend and product engineering. I've shipped user-facing work end to end and improved conversion-critical flows in production.

experience.short: My most relevant experience is shipping TypeScript-first frontend products and improving conversion-critical flows.
experience.medium: I've improved a signup funnel's completion from about 40% to 70% across roughly 250K annual applications, built shared UI libraries, and led frontend quality work in production codebases.
notes: Signup funnel completion improved from ~40% to ~70%

leaving.short: I'm selective about the next role and looking for a good fit on ownership, engineering quality, and product work.
leaving.medium: I'm not leaving because of one specific issue. I'm looking for the next role with real ownership, strong engineering standards, and a sensible long-term match on stack and scope.

salary.short: My target range is around EUR {salary_target}, depending on scope, level, and total package.
salary.medium: My target is around EUR {salary_target} total cash, and I would usually look for at least EUR {salary_min} for the right fit. I am open to discussing the full package based on scope and seniority.

availability.short: I can start interview conversations immediately and confirm exact start timing during the process.
availability.medium: I can start interview conversations immediately. I prefer to confirm exact notice period and start timing once process details are clear.

generic.short: This role looks close to work I have done well before: TypeScript-first product engineering and end-to-end feature ownership.
generic.medium: My background is most relevant where the role needs strong frontend or product-engineering execution, cross-functional delivery, and disciplined quality.
